references.text: The robe is mentioned as part of the holy garments that were to be made for Aaron.
Fulfillment of the command to make the robe from blue wool.
Moses clothed Aaron with the robe during the consecration of the priests.
Description of the ephod, under which the robe was to be worn.
Blue wool (tekhelet) is mentioned as one of the materials that were to be gathered for the sanctuary.
Blue thread (tekhelet) was to be used in the tassels on the garments as a reminder of the Lord's commands.
